title: Pin remote image, crawler and importer fetches to a public DNS answer (SCAN-1123)
detail: The OG remote image fetch, the importer crawler (lib/ai/web) and importer media capture used global fetch behind a hostname check only, so a public name resolving to a private address, or a redirect to one, reached the server network. All three now go through lib/net/pinned-fetch.ts: resolve once, refuse any non-global address (private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, benchmarking, multicast, documentation, NAT64, 6to4, Teredo, IPv4-mapped), pin the socket, follow redirects by hand and re-check each hop, cap bytes and time. Same technique as the QR logo fetch (#3919).

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; unit tests added alongside (lib/net/pinned-fetch.test.ts, scripts/maintenance/live-catalog.test.ts).
